svg.title: Discover Southern Vietnam: eight-day route
svg.desc: Start in Ho Chi Minh City on days 1–3, with a return excursion to the Mekong Delta on day 3. Fly to Hue on day 4 and stay through day 5. Travel by road via Hai Van Pass to Hoi An on day 6, stay on day 7, and transfer to Da Nang airport to depart on day 8.
svg.text: Route lines are illustrative. Map data: Natural Earth (public domain).
